doc_name: 国务院关于加快推进产能过剩行业结构调整的通知（国发〔2006〕11号）
quote_zh: 原则上不批准建设新的钢厂，对个别结合搬迁、淘汰落后生产能力的钢厂项目，要从严审批
quote_en: In principle no new steel mills will be approved; the few relocation / obsolete-capacity-replacement projects must be strictly vetted.
notes: Also: 淘汰300立方米以下炼铁高炉和20吨以下炼钢转炉、电炉; consolidation into groups above 30 Mt. Other side: 支持大型钢铁集团的重大技改和新产品项目.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快推进产能过剩行业结构调整的通知（国发〔2006〕11号）
quote_zh: 钢铁、电解铝、电石、铁合金、焦炭、汽车等行业产能已经出现明显过剩
quote_en: Capacity in steel, electrolytic aluminium, calcium carbide, ferroalloy, coke, autos etc. is already clearly excessive.
notes: Only generic wording: named as overcapacity and 对…发展规划和产业政策，要强化落实; no sector-specific measure.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快推进产能过剩行业结构调整的通知（国发〔2006〕11号）
quote_zh: 关闭淘汰敞开式和生产能力低于1万吨的小电石炉
quote_en: Close and eliminate open-type and sub-10,000-tonne small calcium-carbide furnaces.
notes: Mapping to 化学原料 is a judgement (carbide is a chlor-alkali / basic chemical input).

doc_name: 国务院关于加快推进产能过剩行业结构调整的通知（国发〔2006〕11号）
quote_zh: 尽快淘汰5000千伏安以下铁合金矿热炉（特种铁合金除外）
quote_en: Quickly eliminate ferroalloy submerged-arc furnaces below 5,000 kVA (special ferroalloys excepted).
notes: Mapped to 冶钢原料 (ferroalloy is a steelmaking input); L2 is a judgement.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快推进产能过剩行业结构调整的通知（国发〔2006〕11号）
quote_zh: 彻底淘汰土焦和改良焦设施
quote_en: Completely eliminate native-coke and improved-coke facilities.
notes: Also: 突破现有焦化企业的生产经营格局，实施与钢铁企业、化工企业的兼并联合 (restructuring).

doc_name: 国务院关于加快推进产能过剩行业结构调整的通知（国发〔2006〕11号）
quote_zh: 还必须满足产销量达到批准产能80%以上的要求
quote_en: They must also meet the requirement that output and sales reach over 80% of approved capacity.
notes: Condition added for all new vehicle-assembly firms and cross-category projects of existing firms (sentence continues from 所有新建汽车整车生产企业…). Other side: 支持汽车生产企业加强研发体系建设.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快推进产能过剩行业结构调整的通知（国发〔2006〕11号）
quote_zh: 逐步淘汰立窑等落后的水泥生产能力
quote_en: Gradually eliminate shaft-kiln and other backward cement capacity.
notes: Also 鼓励大型水泥企业集团对中小水泥厂实施兼并、重组、联合. Described as roughly balanced now but with large capacity under construction.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快推进产能过剩行业结构调整的通知（国发〔2006〕11号）
quote_zh: 淘汰达不到产业政策规定规模和安全标准的小煤矿
quote_en: Eliminate small coal mines that fail the scale and safety standards of industrial policy.
notes: Also raise shaft-size standards for new mines. Other side: 支持高产高效煤炭矿井建设和煤矿安全技术改造; 支持大型煤炭企业收购、兼并小煤矿.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快推进产能过剩行业结构调整的通知（国发〔2006〕11号）
quote_zh: 逐步关停小油机和5万千瓦及以下凝汽式燃煤小机组
quote_en: Gradually shut down small oil-fired units and coal-fired condensing units of 50 MW and below.
notes: Electricity is named as a potential-overcapacity sector. Other side: 推进火电机组以大代小、上煤压油等工程.

doc_name: 国务院关于加快推进产能过剩行业结构调整的通知（国发〔2006〕11号）
quote_zh: 支持纺织关键技术、成套设备的研发和产业集群公共创新平台、服装自主品牌的建设
quote_en: Support textile key-technology and complete-equipment R&D, cluster public innovation platforms and own-brand apparel.
notes: Named as potential-overcapacity sector (在建规模很大) but the only measure is support for upgrading; no restriction wording.
